## 🎯 The Problem

Action buttons (edit, delete) in dashboard pages use this pattern:
```tsx
className="opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"
```

This makes buttons **invisible until mouse hover**, breaking functionality on:
- 📱 Touch devices (tablets, phones)
- ⌨️ Keyboard navigation
- 🎯 Screen readers

**Impact:** Restaurant staff using tablets cannot access edit/delete functions!

---

## 💡 The Solution

Change to:
```tsx
className="opacity-70 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"
```

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Always visible (70% opacity)
- ✅ Still has hover feedback (100% on hover)
- ✅ Works on all devices
- ✅ Simple CSS change
